g_d85a2495c20f.title: Add constantCase (SCREAMING_SNAKE) to scule with tests and README note

anchorAsk.text: Add a `constantCase` to scule, the SCREAMING_SNAKE style: "fooBar" becomes "FOO_BAR" and "foo-bar_baz" becomes "FOO_BAR_BAZ". Export it like the other case functions, add tests, and mention it in the README.
